verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS platform with an API, service keys and an MCP server, so a sandbox or test tenant is a fair thing to ask about. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox environment, test mode, or non-production workspace. Workspace selection during MCP OAuth, scoped service keys and role-based permissions limit what an agent can do, but they are adjacent access controls, not isolation from production data. Its DAST application testing is a different product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
